about_the_game:
The era of sky pirates has begun! Captain your own airship in search of the ultimate treasure. To do that, you'll need to build a deck of unit and skill cards. Engage in tactical turn based combat as you defend your airship from raiders and enemy sky pirates in a steampunk world.

Choose Your Captain

Start your adventure by choosing a captain. Each captain starts with different bonuses and are allied with different guilds, allowing for customised playstyles.

Explore Floating Cities

To survive, you'll need all the help you can get. Choose between 2 cities to visit before each combat. Every city presents an opportunity to scout for new crew members, repair and upgrade your ship and encounter random events. Making the correct choice could mean the difference between life and death.

Customize Your Airship

Outfit your ship with cannons to deal with oncoming threats. Cannons need to be crewed by unit cards in order to fire, but once they're loaded, they'll be able to aid you in combat by directly dispatching enemies, or providing buffs to allies.

Strategic Deck Building

Your deck, your choice. Craft your deck with your favourite strategies. Enlist the aid of different guilds, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. From the valiant Adventurer's guild, resourceful Cannoneer's guild to the crafty Inventor's guild, it's up to you to mix and match them to create your perfect strategy.
